Emergencies

สถานะเชื้อเพลิงต่ำ

A condition where the fuel remaining is less than planned final reserve but not yet an emergency.

Definition

A condition where the fuel remaining is less than planned final reserve but not yet an emergency.

Operational example

Center, Speedbird 150 reporting low fuel state, request descent to conserve fuel.
